_doc: Wording for the generated data changelog on /county-profiles/about/changelog/ (site/_includes/county-profiles/data-changelog.njk) and its Atom feed; the entries themselves are built from the snapshot archive at build time (scripts/county-profiles/data-changelog.js), so nothing here lists a refresh. `kinds` labels each kind of changelog entry, for this changelog and the methodology changelog (site/_data/changelog/county-profiles.json, rendered by site/_includes/about-changelog.njk); an entry of any other type fails the build. `sourceNames` names a source in a vintage change where its snapshot label is ambiguous (both BEA entries share one label); the data PR's Changes section uses the same names. `notes` is optional, per refresh date: `note` is shown with that date's entry and `counties` (by FIPS) with a county's line. A note explains a change the data cannot explain by itself (a FEMA LOMR, a deleted USGS record, a publisher's revision). Plain fact: no "I" or "we", no em dashes. The build fails if a note names a date with no dated snapshot directory or a county with no snapshot that date. See docs/COUNTY-PROFILES.md, "The data changelog".
heading: Data changelog
intro: Each entry is a refresh that published new dated snapshots, newest first, built from the snapshot archive when the site is built. Each county is compared with its own previous dated snapshot. Refreshes that changed no figures publish no new snapshot and are not listed.

detail.caption: Figures that changed in {county} County since {previous}

sourceNames.qcew-wages: BLS QCEW, marine wages comparison year
sourceNames.qcew-total-wages: BLS QCEW, total economy wages comparison year

2026-10-22.note: Marine economy GDP moved from 2024 to 2025. BEA revised its 2025 GDP by industry, so total economy GDP changed with no change of source year.

counties.06013: FEMA Letter of Map Revision 25-09-0871P (effective 2026-10-13). USGS deleted two records: Contra Costa College Campus Police and CHP Golden Gate Division Martinez.
counties.06055: USGS deleted one record: Rutherford Fire Department.
